d_ml_015.normalized_query: हैदराबाद के ऑर्डर के लिए औसत डिलीवरी देरी कितने घंटे की है?
d_ml_015.executed_sql:
SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (oe.delivered_at - f.promised_at)) / 3600) AS avg_delivery_delay_hours
FROM orders o
JOIN fulfillments f ON o.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN delivery_events oe ON f.fulfillment_id = oe.fulfillment_id
JOIN locations l ON o.ship_to_location_id = l.location_id
WHERE l.city_local = 'हैदराबाद';

d_ml_015.normalized_query: What is the average delivery delay in हैदराबाद in hours?
d_ml_015.executed_sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.occurred_at - f.promised_at)) / 3600) AS avg_delivery_delay_hours
FROM 
    delivery_events e
JOIN 
    fulfillments f ON e.fulfillment_id = f.fulfillment_id
JOIN 
    locations l ON e.location_id = l.location_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON f.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE 
    l.city_local = 'हैदराबाद'
GROUP BY 
    l.city_local
LIMIT 1000;

FROM fulfillments f

WHERE o.order_channel = 'b2b' AND f.promised_at IS NOT NULL AND f.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
